title: Silent 911 Call — SIP Trunk Group A

fields.systemName: CallPoint Voice Recorder - SIP Trunk Group A

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Sup, this is Call Taker on Position 3. I just took a 911 call on SIP trunk group A — it was completely silent. No audio, no background noise, just dead air. It lasted 45 seconds and then dropped. The ANI shows 555-0199. I've never seen anything like it.

transcript.speaker: Supervisor
transcript.text: Got it. Confirm it was on SIP trunk group A, not B. Mark the call as 'Silent' in CAD, and log it using form RCECD-F-11. I'll notify Tech to check for TDoS indicators.

instructorNote: This is the first silent call from a spoofed number. The supervisor must initiate SOP 5.2 and alert Tech to monitor for TDoS patterns. Watch for delayed escalation or incorrect form use.
